lines.text: Say some advice, not an advice!
Many learners say: Can you give me an advice?
Better: Can you give me some advice?
Some! Can you give me some advice?

data.wrong: Can you give me an advice?
data.right: Can you give me some advice?

native.tip: advice는 하나, 둘 셀 수 없는 말이라서 an을 붙이지 않아요. an 대신 some! 이렇게 말해요 👉 “Can you give me some advice?”
native.caption: “Can you give me an advice?”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 advice는 하나, 둘 세지 않는 말이라서 an 대신 some을 써요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “Can you give me some advice?” Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답 ✅ “Can you give me some advice?” 소리 내어 한 번 말해 보고, 나만의 문장도 하나 써 보세요: {link}

en.tip: You do not count advice, so say some. Say “Can you give me some advice?”
en.caption: Do you say it like this? 😅 “Can you give me an advice?” You do not count advice, so say some. Right: “Can you give me some advice?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
